## Summary

I relocated the eval utility modules into a shared `src/util/eval/` layer and kept the old evalTableUtils path working via a re-export shim.

**Moves** (via `git mv`, so history is preserved):
- `src/server/utils/evalTableUtils.ts` → `src/util/eval/evalTableUtils.ts`
- `src/commands/eval/filterTests.ts` → `src/util/eval/filterTests.ts`
- `src/commands/eval/filterPrompts.ts` → `src/util/eval/filterPrompts.ts`
- `src/commands/eval/filterProviders.ts` → `src/util/eval/filterProviders.ts`
- `src/commands/eval/filterTestsUtil.ts` → `src/util/eval/filterTestsUtil.ts`

Because `src/commands/eval/`, `src/server/utils/`, and `src/util/eval/` are all two levels below `src/`, every relative import inside the moved files stayed valid without edits.
